item.title: google-genai 3.0.0 (pypi) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: ### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES * **Default Gemini Developer API version is now `v1` (was `v1beta`)** ([2d0f947](https://github.com/googleapis/python-genai/commit/2d0f9476ae5c7a6d3c90f81b056fad0315be5b60)) Quote: * **Default HTTP client is now `httpx2` (was `httpx`), and `httpx` is no longer installed by default** ([51285c8](https://github.com/googleapis/python-genai/commit/51285c87a4394d3e895df07af7664df5cd1c30de)) Quote: * **`httpx` is no longer installed by default.** `httpx2` is now the required dependency and default HTTP client. Release notes: https://github.com/googleapis/python-genai/releases/tag/v3.0.0 Errata correction: https://formachines.ai/errata/pypi/google-genai/
